title: Enquiry about Airmail
transcript:
SCRIPT:
Speaker 2: Hello? Jennifer speaking.
Speaker 0: Hello Jennifer. My name’s Ben Smith. I’m from the New Zealand Post Office Service. I understand you left a couple of questions on our website forum. Seeing as though you left your phone number as a contact, I thought you might prefer us to call.
Speaker 2: Oh Ben! Its nice to speak to you again. I really appreciate your help last month. Yes, as I will be moving to Australia soon and need to send some of my things via airmail, I just wasn’t sure how to get my mail redirected.
Speaker 0: I can help you with that. It’s interesting that I recently got more inquiries about international mailing due to migration to other countries. May I ask why you are moving? Umm.
. .
Speaker 2: There are a few reasons such as I have family in Australia and the weather there is warmer, but mainly because it hard to find a job here . I have just got the news that I was successful in applying for a job in Australia! I’ll be starting in November.
Speaker 0: How exciting, congratulations! I have never been to Australia, but I’ve heard it’s a nice place. Is it a permanent job?
Speaker 2: No, I will only be working for that company as a temporary assistant over this summer . You never know I might get homesick and want to come back after a few months anyway!
Speaker 0: I hope the job goes well for you. What postal address will you be using in Australia?
Speaker 2: I had organized some accommodation at a hostel in Sydney for the first week,but that fell through, so I will stay at my friend’s house until I find somewhere else. My things will have to be sent to her place for now and the address is 9 Queen Street, Sydney .
Speaker 0: Can I know how long you will be staying there? We want to make sure you get your mail while you are there.
Speaker 2: I will be staying there for the first two months . You know, it’s free staying with her.
Speaker 0: That’s nice! Now, I’ve got a couple more questions for you. What is your full name and current address?
Speaker 2: My name is Jennifer Simmons.
Speaker 0: How do you spell your surname, please?
Speaker 2: It’s S-I-M-M-O-N-S . Got that.
Speaker 0: And your address, please?
Speaker 2: Oh, right. I’m currently living at 16 Ocean Road, Auckland .
Speaker 0: And your postcode?
Speaker 2: It’s 0245.
Speaker 0: That doesn’t come up in our system as a valid postcode. Can you check that again, please?
Speaker 2: Yes, sorry! I’m not good at remembering numbers. It’s 0425.
Speaker 0: When would you like your things to be air mailed?
Speaker 2: I will leave New Zealand on the 23rd of September, but I will try to send them on the 22nd . so that’s the day before. How long will it take for my things to get to Australia?
Speaker 0: It will take about a week.
Speaker 2: Perfect. That should give me time to get organized in Australia before everything arrives.
Speaker 0: May I ask about the content of your delivery? There are some things you have to sign a goods declaration for, such as expensive items or if you are importing medications in bulk.
Speaker 2: I won’t be sending anything like that. It’ll mainly be personal items. I was thinking of posting some books. But I guess that’s quite expensive because they are heavy. And my guitar is kind of big.
Speaker 0: Yes, it can be quite expensive.
Speaker 2: Ummm.
. .
Speaker 2: I might not send them then. I definitely need to send some of my files . I have one standard-size file box full of them.
Speaker 0: Sure. Anything else?
Speaker 2: I’ve heard the beaches and the ocean are beautiful in Australia. I enjoy diving so I’m going to send my diving gear as well . I have packed it into a box to send it more easily. Would you mind if I weighed everything and sent you information to get a quote on the price?
Speaker 0: Just send it to info@postalservice.nz. Can I help you with anything else?
Speaker 2: No, that’s everything. Thank you for your help!

questions.explanation:
Hello? Jennifer speaking.
Hello Jennifer. My name's Ben Smith. I'm from the New Zealand Post Office Service.
I understand you left a couple of questions on our website forum.
Seeing as though you left your phone number as a contact, I thought you might prefer us to call.
Oh Ben! Its nice to speak to you again. I really appreciate your help last month.
Yes, as I will be moving to Australia soon and need to send some of my things via airmail, I just wasn't sure how to get my mail redirected.
I can help you with that.
It’s interesting that I recently got more inquiries about international mailing due to migration to other countries. May I ask why you are moving?
{Umm. . . There are a few reasons such as I have family in Australia and the weather there is warmer, but mainly because it hard to find a job here ][1]}.
I have just got the news that I was successful in applying for a job in Australia! I'll be starting in November.
How exciting, congratulations! I have never been to Australia, but I've heard it's a nice place. Is it a permanent job?
{No, I will only be working for that company as a temporary assistant over this summer ][2]}.
You never know I might get homesick and want to come back after a few months anyway!
I hope the job goes well for you. What postal address will you be using in Australia?
I had organized some accommodation at a hostel in Sydney for the first week,{but that fell through, so I will stay at my friend's house until I find somewhere else. My things will have to be sent to her place for now and the address is 9 Queen Street, Sydney ][3]}.
Can I know how long you will be staying there? We want to make sure you get your mail while you are there.
{I will be staying there for the first two months ][4]}. You know, it's free staying with her.
That’s nice! Now, I've got a couple more questions for you. What is your full name and current address?
My name is Jennifer Simmons.

How do you spell your surname, please?
{It's S-I-M-M-O-N-S ][5]}.
Got that. And your address, please?
{Oh, right. I'm currently living at 16 Ocean Road, Auckland ][6]}.
And your postcode?
{It's 0245.
That doesn't come up in our system as a valid postcode. Can you check that again, please?
Yes, sorry! I'm not good at remembering numbers. It's 0425 [7]}.
When would you like your things to be air mailed?
{I will leave New Zealand on the 23rd of September, but I will try to send them on the 22nd ][8]}.
so that's the day before. How long will it take for my things to get to Australia?
It will take about a week.
quotes: There are a few reasons such as I have family in Australia and the weather there is warmer, but mainly because it hard to find a job here .
